query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM import_target_reservation
            WHERE channel_id = $1 AND team_id <> $2
        ) OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM import_entity
            WHERE source = 'slack' AND status = 'imported' AND entity_type = 'channel'
              AND entity_id = $1::text AND team_id <> $2
        ) AS "exists!"
